name: ssl-bc2-mix-glue
description: The classic SSL stereo-bus 'mix glue' on a full mix via SSL Native Bus Compressor 2: gentle 2:1, 10 ms attack, AUTO release, ~2 dB GR, with the sidechain HPF (~60 Hz) engaged so the kick/bass stop pumping the whole mix. The textbook 2-bus setting — a finalize-mix glue stage, NOT a master.
intended_for: a near-final full stereo mix bus (the finalize-mix stage, BEFORE mastering/limiting)
plugin_build: SSL Native Bus Compressor 2.vst3 (SSL Native; renders headless via Pedalboard — re-verify on a new machine)
notes: 2:1 + AUTO + 1-3 dB GR is the famous transparent 'glue'. Keep GR LOW on a full mix — re-dial threshold to land ~2 dB (threshold is relative to input level; lower = more GR).

S/C HPF ~60 Hz measured = kick leaves the detector: GR drops (8.9->7.8 dB) and the kick punches ~1 dB more through. Raise toward 90-120 Hz if the low end still pumps the mix. Valid values are NON-ROUND strings (e.g. '59.9','79.9','120.0') from the plugin's list — '60.0' is rejected.
This is a PRE-MASTER glue stage (finalize-mix) — do NOT also limit here. Hand the result to master-track.
Verify: ~1-3 dB GR, crest barely down, LRA slightly tighter, true-peak safe.
